newsitem.title: UK: Enterprise finds oil near N.Sea Captain fiel.
newsitem.headline: Enterprise finds oil near N.Sea Captain fiel.

text.p: British independent Enterprise Oil plc said on Monday it had made an "encouraging" oil discovery near the Central North Sea Captain Field.

In a statement, Enterprise said it discovered oil in Block 13/21a, two kilometers west of Captain, in a "significant" column of similar quality to Captain oil which is expected to begin flowing this month.
The well was plugged and abandoned without testing, Enterprise said. It will propose a 3D seismic programme in 1997, Enterprise UK Exploration Manager Mike Whyatt said.
Enterprise is operator of the block and holds a 51.54 percent share. Other partners in the block are Amerada Hess UK with 28.26 percent and Mobil North Sea Ltd with 20 percent.
